description.desc_thousand_char: PGP Glass Limited (PGL), as per its credit rating, is an end-to-end specialty glass manufacturing and packaging (flaconage) solution provider. The company primarily caters to pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, and perfumery, and specialty food and beverage industries. The company has 2 manufacturing facilities in India–one in Kosumba and Jambusar in Gujarat, and one in Horana in Sri Lanka. The company has a manufacturing capacity of 1,310 TPD (Tonnes Per Day) in India and an additional 300 TPD in Sri Lanka. It is owned by a US Private equity major, Blackstone Group. The company's clientele includes FDC, Titan, Emcure, Pulse, Nestle, Neon, Bacardi, and many more.
